Question Choices: Fill: A rectangle has __ sides, __ right angles, __ pairs of parallel sides.
Solution: A rectangle has 4 straight sides and 4 right angles. Opposite sides are parallel, giving 2 pairs of parallel sides.

Question Choices: A quadrilateral bends inward so that one corner points toward the center. Is it concave or convex?
Hints: An inward corner with an interior angle greater than 180° makes a polygon concave.
Solution: An inward-pointing corner has an interior angle greater than 180°, making the quadrilateral concave.

Question Choices: Select the most specific answer. A quadrilateral has opposite sides parallel, all four sides equal and four right angles. Select the most specific name. ~~Parallelogram | Trapezoid | Rectangle | Square~~
Solution: A square has four equal sides and four right angles. Therefore it is a rectangle, a rhombus, a parallelogram and a quadrilateral. The most specific name is square.

Question Choices: Select. Is every square a rhombus? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus. Four right angles are also needed for a square.
Solution: Yes. Every square has four equal sides and opposite sides parallel, so it satisfies the definition of a rhombus.

Question Choices: A city planner designs a public park with 4 straight borders. The opposite sides are parallel, and all 4 corners form right angles, but the length of the sides are not all equal. What is the most specific name for this park's shape? : Rectangle Square Rhombus Trapezoid
Hints: Check the number of parallel pairs, right angles and equal sides. A shape may belong to several families.
Solution: Four right angles make a rectangle. Unequal adjacent sides rule out a square and a rhombus; opposite sides form two parallel pairs.
